brief.subject: A tidy coil of rope — the item icon for the Rope item in inventory and hotbar
brief.gameplayMeaning: Inventory icon identifying the rope item; must read at a glance as a coiled rope bundle, not a string ball or a wheel
visualPriority: first read as a coiled rope at native 16x16
then show concentric coil rings and a loose end loop
use the rope palette (leather brown) for family consistency

mustHave: circular coil silhouette with concentric ring grooves
a small loop or loose end so it reads as rope, not a wheel
light highlight and dark shadow for volume
